card.name: Company and publisher names
card.fires_on: Names of companies, labs or publishers (Lilly, Laboratories, Monsanto, Columbia) and words like 'by' or 'companies' that point to one. Mostly in drug-label sponsor lines and in news or history text.

modes.label: Drug company names
modes.description: Manufacturer names in label text, such as Lilly or Laboratories after a brand or company.
